summary: Bicycle Therapeutics plc filed an 8-K on May 21, 2026, announcing a press release regarding initial Duravelo-2 Phase 2 data for zelenectide pevedotin in metastatic urothelial cancer presented at ASCO. No deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation are mentioned. The filing is a routine disclosure of clinical trial results and does not involve a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. This is solely an update on scientific data with no corporate event. The filing is standard for a biotech company reporting trial milestones; no risk-arb angle or special situation is present.
